aproposAvenirCorps: To become the reference academic platform in Africa: sharing between universities, revision support and recommendations suited to each programme.
aproposIntro: NextLearn brings together courses, tutorials, summaries and past papers for students in sub-Saharan Africa, in a light mobile app designed to work offline.
aproposMissionCorps: Gather scattered resources and make them available to every student. Knowledge must no longer depend on privileged contacts.
aproposOrigineCorps: Three students at Institut Universitaire Saint-Jean, in Yaoundé, reached the same conclusion: the resources exist, but they are scattered across WhatsApp groups, untidy Drives and hand-to-hand sharing. Newcomers pay the highest price - they know neither where to look, nor what to revise, nor how to find past papers. Access depends on the contacts you have, not on the rights you should have. NextLearn was born to put that right.
aproposValeurExcellenceCorps: Quality and rigour in every detail.
aproposValeurInnovationCorps: Modern technology in the service of education.
